tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang rgyas pa mchog dbang gud sbas dang sbrel nas bskur ba'i cho ga dbang chen gsang ba'i srog tig ces bya ba bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang rgyas pa mchog dbang gud sbas dang sbrel nas bskur ba'i cho ga dbang chen gsang ba'i srog tig ces bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang rgyas pa mchog dbang gud sbas dang sbrel nas bskur ba'i cho ga dbang chen gsang ba'i srog tig ces bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru ma hā shrī ha ya grī bā ya/ bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad 'bar ba chen po'i sku /dngos grub bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis rab rgyas pa// dbang chen he ru ka dpal rgyal kun gyi// gsung gi rdo rjes sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs/ de sgrub bka' gter bye ba phrag brgya'i bcud// lho gter rin chen 'bras bu'i snying po ste// pad+ma zhi khro'i nang tshan drag po'i dbang*// bod yul tsam na zab par bsngags 'di'o// rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang rgyas pa dregs pa srog gi rgya can mchog dbang dang bcas pa ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dkyus gcig tu bskur ba'i tshul lag tu blang bder 'chad pa la don bzhi/ sbyor ba bsham bkod/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur/ rjes kyi zab rgya sogs bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas rten dang rgyan gyis spras par stegs bu la dkyil 'khor dbus su chos 'byung lte bar zla gam sgo gcig pa'i phyi rol du thod phreng*/ de'i phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi rtsibs mchan gri gug gis mtshan pa/ de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de rgyab rin chen zur brgyad/ sgo bzhi rta babs dur khrod pad rwa me ri sogs khro dkyil spyi ltar la lha gnas so sor sku'am sa bon phyag mtshan gyis mtshan pa bkram pa'i dbus su mañdzi la bum pa mgul chings dmar po nyer lnga'i bcud ldan gyi steng du dpal gtor rta mgos mtshan pa/ mdun ngos su e khrom la gtso phur rta zhal gyis mtshan pa bkod/ g.yas g.yon rnams su gtso bo'i sku rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan/ dar sna'i cod pan/ thong phreng*/ thal raka zhag gsum/ glang ko /mi lpags/ stag sham/ sbrul chun/ gri thod/ ral gri/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ dril bu/ lcags sgrog /gzig sham/ rus rgyan/ las phur liṅga dang bcas pa/ tshe gal zas sna rnams dang/ rgyab ngos su bhan+dha mtshan ldan chang dang mngar gsum chos sman sbyar bas bkang ba'i khar me long la sin+dhu ra chang gis brlan par chos 'byung dbus su ma ha ri ni sa dbus dang phyogs bzhir bris pa dar dmar gyis bkab pa/

rig ma'i tsakli rnams bzhag /mdun du sman rag gtor gsum/ chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yas bskor du bsham/ sngon gtor tshogs chas chad brtan sogs dang*/ so shing*/ srung skud dmar po/ ku sha /maṇ+ḍal sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub mchod ni/ skyabs sems dang bgegs gtor spyi 'gro sngon du btang*/ las byang rin chen phreng ba'i bka' bsgo nas brtsam mthar chags su gtang zhing tshig ris gcig gis bdag mdun bum pa gtor ma bcas so sor lhar gsal ba chags med rin po ches bzhed pa ltar ram/ rnying ma spyi ltar thog mar bdag mdun dbyer med bsgrubs nas dzap khang phyes kyang rung la/ gang ltar bzlas pa'i skabs su bdag mdun bum lha'i gtso bo'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i thugs kar nyi steng hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yas su bskor ba las 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis bsgrubs dngos grub thams cad rang la bsdus/ snang grags rig gsum pad+ma dbang gi sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du gsal ba'i ngang las rtsa sngags 'bru bcu bzhi pa brgya stong ci nus bzla/ mthar kha skong 'bru bcu drug pa'ang sbrel nas snga ma'i bcu cha tsam bzla/ dmigs phyed pa'i slad du bum bzlas zur du spro na dmigs pa'i gsal 'debs sogs spyi mthun byas la skabs 'dir bzla/ mthar stong tshigs mchod bstod byas la/ bum pa'i lha tshogs ngo bo dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor la rnam pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu bar gyur/ ces mos/ las kyi bum par pad nyi'i steng du las kyi rta mgrin ljang gu g.yas rgya gram/ g.yon sdigs mdzub sgreng zhing khro bo'i cha lugs ldan pa gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya grī ba a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī nī laṃ ba ra dha ra hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces ci nus bzla/ khro bo 'od du zhu nas bum chu khro chung gi rdul phra rab bgegs thams cad zlog pa'i nus ldan du gyur/

hūm̐: dgongs shig bla ma sogs kyis dbang dang dngos grub blang*/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul bya/ tshogs byin rlabs nas bsgral bstab kyi bar du btang ngo*// gsum pa dbang la gnyis/ sta gon dang*/ dbang dngos so// de'ang spyi'i lugs bzhin dngos sta so sor phral/ dngos gzhi la'ang 'jug pa'i chos dang dbang dngos dbye ba sogs byas na yid la 'bab par 'gyur mod/ da lta'i phyag len du gsang ba spyi'i rigs pas skyabs sems dang*/ dbang dngos gzhi'i gong du slob ma lha bskyed dang byin 'beb sbyar ba tsam las gzhan gter gzhung nar 'ded du bskur bar snang bas de ltar bkod na/ dang po ni/ slob ma rnams khrus bya/ chags med lugs lta bu'i bgegs gtor btang*/ las byang ltar bka' bsgos la hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang yungs dkar gu gul gyi dud pas bgegs bskrad cing srung 'khor brtan por bsgom/ sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de'ang 'og min bde chen pad+ma rnam par bkod pa'i klong du bde ba chen po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug sku dang ye shes tha dad med pa'i tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams rgya mtsho mtha' yas par snang bas/ gsung pad+ma'i chos dbyings dus gsum chad pa med pas pad+ma dbang chen sgyu 'phrul dra ba rnam par rol pa'i rgyud lung man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa chos nyid rdo rje'i rang sgrar bstan cing*/ ston mchog gsung gi rdo rje de nyid thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa la 'phags bod gnyis su grub pa'i slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha ba zhes bya ba'i skur bzhengs nas/ skal pa dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams tshe gcig gis zung 'jug chen po'i sa la sbyor ba'i zab mo'i gdams ngag gang la gang 'dul du ston pa las/ pad+ma gsung gi sgrub lugs rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud kyi bye brag dpal rta mgrin yang gsang spu gri'i rgyud stong phrag rtsa lnga pa'i nang nas drag sngags gnam lcags thog 'dra khol du phyungs pa gsang 'dus rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa la brten nas/

dbang chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub skor man ngag mtha' rgyas dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ bod kyi rje 'bangs grogs lnga dang lo tsā chen po bzhis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor bstsal pa ste/ ji skad du/ khyad par yang zab nga yi thugs dam las: gsang ba 'dus pa zhi dang khro bo'i skor: gnyis las rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa 'di: pad+ma nga yi thugs dam rtsa ba yin: bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma: thugs bcud snying po 'di nyid min re kan: zhes mchog gi dngos grub myur du sgrub pa'i zhor la thun mong gi dngos grub 'bad med du stsol ba/ khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon par byed pa'i zab chos khyad par du 'phags pa 'di nyid dbyangs can ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis bka' bsdus/ lo tsā rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis shog ser la bkod de la yag mon mkhar steng gi pha wang g.yu sgrom gyi byang*/ lho brag gnam skas can gyi brag ri'i shar phyogs stag lpags brgyangs 'dra'i dkyil du rten mchog dam rdzas khyad par can dang bcas te zab mo'i gter du sba bar mdzad pa las/ phyis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phrin las kyi dus su son pa'i tshe lang gro lo tsā ba'i yang srid sprul pa'i gter chen rat+na gling pas ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul brjod las 'das pa dang bcas te dam chos 'dus pa skor bzhi'i zab chos rnams khrom gter du spyan drangs/ gtsang dbus khams gsum du phrin las rgya che la rgyun chags par spel ba rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa la smin byed kyi dbang bskur rgyas pa dregs pa srog gi rgya can mchog dbang dang 'brel ba/ bsdus pa gtor dbang sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang dang bcas pa gnyis su bzhugs pa las da lam dbang bskur rgyas pa bsgrub pa yin/ de la'ang sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis su yod pa las thog mar 'jug pa sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/

zhes mtshams sbyar la maṇ+ḍal 'bul gzhug / sngon chad ma rig pa'i sgrib pas mig ldongs shing ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ma mjal ba mtshon pa'i mig dar dmar po 'ching zhing*/ rig pa rang snang gi lha dang mjal ba'i phyag rten du kha dog lnga pa'i me tog gi chun po phyag tu thogs par mos mdzod/ mig dar me tog gtad/ snyim pa me tog gis bkang ba'i thal mo zlum por sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyai: dkyil 'khor kun gyi mnga' bdag gtso: bdag nyid chen po dbang gi bdag: khyod ni brtse chen gar dbang che: bdag cag smin par mdzad du gsol: lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas snod rung du gzigs nas gnang ba bstsal bar mos shig /dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di nyid du: 'jug tu rung ba'i skyes bu ni: skal ldan brgya lam 'ga' zhig ni: dam tshig ldan na bdag gis bzung: bla ma dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor tha dad med pa dbang chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la dkon mchog rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar du snying thag pa nas skyabs su mchi'o snyam pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ na mo: bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ thabs khyad par du gyur pa gsag sbyang yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bya ba'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ rang rig lha la phyag 'tshal lo: ma 'gags rang gsal mchod pa 'bul: mu bzhir ltung ba mthol lo bshags: dus gsum mnyam nyid rjes yi rang: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bskul: ka dag zang thal rjen par bzhugs: kun kyang rang rig rtogs par bsngo: sku gsum yongs rdzogs thob par shog: gsum mam gcig / mkha' khyab kyi skye dgu thams cad dpal pad+ma dbang chen gyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/

de'i ched du smin byed zab mo gsan la grol byed lam gyi rim pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la blo bzhag bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ma bdag gis 'gro kun bsgral bya'i phyir: rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bskul: tshad med bzhi ru sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ tshom bu lnga ldan gyi maṇ+ḍal 'du bya/ so shing gtad la/ rigs dang phrin las kyi 'brel ba brtag pa'i phyir so shing 'di nyid thal mo'i bar du zungs la tshig 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas te tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du 'dor 'tshal/ dbang chen lha yi dkyil 'khor ni: las dang skal ldan smon lam gyis: las kyi 'brel pa bstan du gsol: badz+ra hā sa ha sa ti ho: zhes 'dor du gzhug / de ltar dor bas so shing gi rtse mo phyogs bzhi dbus lngar bstan pas phrin las bzhi dang mchog 'grub cing*/ mtshams rnams su dngos grub phran tshegs 'grub par gsungs so// srung skud dmar po rdo rje'i mdud pa can rtsa sngags kyis btab la/ sngags kyi rdo rje'i srad bu dpung par bcings pas sgo gsum bar chad thams cad las srung bar mos shig /hūm̐: sra brtan rdo rje 'bar ba ste: cis kyang mi shigs rgyas gdab bo: badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon/ bud med kyi g.yas su bcings la rdo rje'i rgyas gdab/ ku sha gtad la/ hūm̐: sngon yang ston pa 'jig rten mgon: rtswa mchog gdan la gnas pa ltar: khyod kyang 'di la stan byas la: lha dang skal pa mnyam par shog: de dag gis sta gon gyi chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi'i sngon du 'gro ba bgegs srung zhing dam la bzhag par bya ba yin pas snyan gtod 'tshal/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ hūm̐: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs: gsang ba'i 'khor lo rgya dang bcas: bar chad kun gyis mi tshugs shing: dam tshig tshul bzhin gnas par mdzod:

deng phyin chad rtsa ba dang yan lag gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bya dgos shing de'i dpang por rdo rje'i chu nan sbyin pa yin pas don thugs la nges 'tshal/ dam chu sbyin la/ hūm̐: ye shes rdo rje skyed byed pa'i: 'di ni nyams na dmyal ba'i chu: 'di nyid nyams par ma gyur na: dam srung dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: badz+ra sa ma ya ti hūm̐: brgyud pa phyi ma rnams kyi phyag srol ltar skabs 'dir ye shes 'beb par spro na/ de nas dbang gi gzhi 'god pa la sgo gsum gyi gnad rnam par bcun te dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ las bum gyi chu dang las sngags kyis bsang*/ shūn+ya tā 'i sngags kyis sbyang*/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul dag pa gsum: me chu rlung gi bskal pa stongs: stong nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin las: rang sems rig pa'i ngo bo ni: yi ge hrīḥyi 'phro 'du las: dregs pa lha brgyad sogs nas/ spyi bor phag zhal ngur sgra sgrog: ces pa'i bar las byang ltar 'don/ de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po dang nyi steng thugs srog hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa'i 'od zer dang*/ bla ma dkyil 'khor pa las kyang 'od zer gyi pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i pho brang nas/ dbang chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams lha sngags phyag rgya 'od dang thig le'i rnam par kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas lus ngag yid gsum la sib sib thim par mos shig / bsdu na byin 'beb/ rgyas par spro na spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad brjod/ sngags sgra sbyar spos rol mo bcas pas byin dbab la/ ye shes pa byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par gyur cig /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes rdo rje mgor bzhag /tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'du byas la/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis pa me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin snang ba la/

khyed rang gi tshe rabs nas 'brel ba'i rigs kyi lha la phog par gyur cig snyam pa'i mos pa dang tshig 'di'i rjes zlos bcas me tog 'dor ba zhu/ ho: yi dam lha ni thugs rje'i bdag: sngon nas las 'phro gang yod pa'i: dkyil 'khor gcig pa 'grub par shog: puṣ+pe sid+dhi ho: zhes 'dor du gzhug go / ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs mig dar dang lhan cig tu bsal bar mos shig / gser thur gyis mig dar bsal la/ kye: ma rig 'khrul pas rab bsgribs pas: ye shes snang ba'i sgo bcad pa: ye shes 'char ba'i sgo nyid du: yang dag thabs dang ldan pas dbye: oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣuḥpra be sha ya phaṭa: ces mig dar bsal/ ye shes kyi spyan dri ma dang bral ba thob nas dbang chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du mjal bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod cig / gnyis pa dbang dngos la bzhi/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ spros med tshig dbang rin po che'o// dang po la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur yongs rdzogs zhu ba'i slad du maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/

ces dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye: rigs kyi bdag nyid dbang chen sku: shin tu gsang ba'i dbang mchog nyid: rdo rje 'dzin gyis bdag la bskur: bka' dang dam la 'da' re kan: de nas dbang dngos la rnam grangs nyer gnyis yod pa'i dang po dbu rgyan gyi dbang ni/ khyed rang rnams dbang chen rta mchog he ru ka'i skur gsal ba'i spyi bor thod pa'i khang bu'i nang du pad+ma he ru ka gtso bor gyur pa'i khrag 'thung rigs lnga rgyan cha lugs yongs rdzogs su gsal ba la/ dbu rgyan ye shes sems dpa' rigs lnga'i rang bzhin spyi bor bzhag pa tsam gyis dam tshig ye shes gnyis med du byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ thod pa'i dbu rgyan bkon la/ hūm̐: srid pa gsum la dbang sgyur phyir: byang chub sems ni mngon du bsten: khams gsum ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir: dbu la rigs lngas dbang bskur ro: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: ho: skal ldan khyod la dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur pas: 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi skal pa mnyam par gyur cig: gnyis pa cod pan gyi dbang ni/ sngar rigs kyi lha la phul ba'i cod pan de nyid dbang rtags kyi tshul du spyi bor bcings par mos shig / cod pan sngar phul ba de nyid spyi bor bcings la/ hūm̐: 'khor 'das ma lus zil gnon zhing: bcom ldan lha dang skal pa mnyam: rgyal srid chos kyi mnga' gsol phyir: gtsug tu cod pan dbang bskur ro: oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta dharma kā ya hūm̐ ā: ho: skal ldan khyod la cod pan gyi dbang bskur pas: chos kyi rgyal po 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan dam par gyur cig: gsum pa gtor ma'i dbang ni/ dpal gtor rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs su gsal ba'i gnas gsum nas sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros/

khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du byin gyis brlabs par mos shig / dpal gtor thogs la/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs mchog 'dus pa'i dpal: ha ya grī ba dpal gyi sku: skal ldan lus ngag yid gsum la: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur ro: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ha ya grī ba kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes gnas gsum du gtugs/ bzhi pa bum pa'i dbang ni/ bum pa rang byung gi gzhal yas khang du dbang chen rta mgrin gtso 'khor dang bcas par gsal ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung*/ sgo gsum dri ma mtha' dag gtor zhing dbang bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la blugs pa'i bya ba mthar phyin par mos shig / rnam bum thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa'i ngo bo chos kyi sku: bum pa'i rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs: bum chu thugs rje sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum yongs rdzogs dbang bskur ro: oṃ hrīḥha ya grī ba a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: bum pa gnas gsum du gtugs shing rtsa sngags sham bur/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes brjod/ ho: skal ldan khyod la bum pa'i dbang bskur bas: lus ngag yid gsum dag pa'i sku gsung thugs su gyur nas: 'bras bu sku bzhi'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig: lnga pa rgyan chas thod phreng ni/ dpal gyi rtags dang chas gos phyag mtshan rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rje btsan chen por mnga' thob par mos shig /hūm̐: 'du byed lnga bcu gnas dag pas: dpal chen sku yi rgyan du che: thod phreng mi mgo'i dbang bskur ro: khams gsum zil gnon dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra ke ra ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: drug pa thal raka zhag gi rtags gsum gdab la/ hūm̐: dpral bar thal chen tshom bu'i rgyan: mkhur bar dmar chen rak+ta'i thig:

rngam byed zhag gi zo ris dpa': khro chen rtags kyi dbang bskur ro: badz+ra rak+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bdun pa glang lpags thogs la/ hūm̐: gti mug rnam dag glang chen lpags: khams gsum yongs sgrol rab tu 'jigs: glang chen ko rlon dbang bskur ro: che btsan dbang mchog thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra hasti a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: brgyad pa mi lpags thogs la/ hūm̐: zhing bcu yongs sgrol zhing lpags klub: rtog med chos kyi dbyings su rol: g.yang gzhi 'bar bas dbang bskur ro: dregs pa kun 'dul dbang thob shog: badz+ra ma taṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dgu pa stag sham thogs la/ hūm̐: dpal chen gzi brjid stobs ldan pa: stag sham 'di ni dpa' ba'i rtags: 'jigs byed 'bar bas dbang bskur bas: srid gsum zil gnon dbang thob shog: badz+ra bhi shwa kro ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bcu pa sbrul chun thogs la/ hūm̐: gti mug nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod: dregs 'joms sbrul chun dbang bskur ro: gdug pa ma lus tshar bcad nas: mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i dbang thob shog: badz+ra ha la shud+dhe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bcu gcig pa gri thod lag g.yas g.yon du gtad la: hūm̐: gri gug 'khor ba'i skye 'chi gcod: thod khrag rtog med dbyings su rol: dbang chen yab yum phyag mtshan 'dis: phrin las yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: ha ya grī ba dhā ki nī mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ ā: bcu gnyis pa g.yas su ral gri dang kha ṭ+wāṃ gtad la: hūm̐: shes rab ral gris log rtog gcod: kha ṭ+wāṃ dug gsum dbyings su sgrol: gnyis med chos dbyings rol pa che: nyon mongs bdud 'joms dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra khat+ga hā ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bcu gsum pa g.yon du dril bu dang lcags sgrog gtad la: hūm̐: shes rab dril bu chos kyi sgra: dbang gi lcags sgrog khams gsum sdud: dbang gi phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs dbang: bdud bzhi tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra mu tra bha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

bcu bzhi pa yum gyi gzig sham thogs la: hūm̐: mi snyems skyon bral rab tu dga': zil gnon yum chen dpa' ba'i rtags: snang srid zil gnon dbang thob shog: badz+ra mu tra dha rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bco lnga pa rgyan drug thogs la: hūm̐: phar phyin drug ldan rnam thar brgyad: sa lam yongs rdzogs 'khor ba sgrol: yon tan rab rdzogs rus pa'i rgyan: theg dgu yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: badz+ra dharma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bcu drug pa gtso phur gtad la: hūm̐: dbang chen 'bar ba kī la ya: gzir ba tsam gyis rdul du rlog: btab na lha yang brlag par byed: dgra bgegs tsam la smos ci dgos: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha ya grī ba kī li kī la ya phaṭaḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bcu bdun pa las phur 'dril zhing gtad: liṅga mdun du bkod la/ hūm̐: 'jigs byed 'bar ba drag po'i lha: me dpung 'bar ba'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: bdud sde log 'dren tshar gcod phyir: mngon spyod drag po'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya grī ba kī li kī la ya phaṭa: ha ya grī ba dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa: gsal ba gsum ldan gyi ngang du tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa dang ldan pas dmigs pa'i 'ben la rdeg par 'tshal/ zhes brda sbyar nas liṅga la brdeg du gzhug /bco brgyad pa bdud rtsi'i dbang ni/ lha tshogs yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i bdud rtsi byang sems kyi dbang bskur bas rtsa khams bde ba chen por smin par mos shig / bhan+dha'i bdud rtsi sbyin la/ hūm̐: nga ni dbang chen 'bar ba'i sku: 'khor ba dbyings su sgrol ba'i phyir: gsang ba byang sems dbang bskur bas: bde stong dbyer med dbang thob shog: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta a ho su kha a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: bcu dgu pa sgom pa'i dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa 'phros nas slob ma'i spyi bor thim pas snang ba thams cad gsal stong lha'i dkyil 'khor du 'char ba'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag par gyur/

gtso bo'i sku spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐: dbang chen sku yi dkyil 'khor ni: rab 'jigs khros pa gar dgu'i bdag: sgyu ma chu zla bzhin du sgoms: gnyis med sku yi dbang thob shog: hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha ya grī ba a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: nyi shu pa bzlas pa'i dbang ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥ'i mthar sngags phreng pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas/ sngags phreng gnyis pa chad de zhal nas thon/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi steng sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phreng ba sbrel la rtsa sngags sham bu bcas pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ sgra grags thams cad grags stong sngags kyi rang bzhin du 'char ba'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag par mos shig / phreng ba lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: ma 'gags tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs ni: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor chu bo'i rgyun: bde gshegs ma lus kun 'grub nas: bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra dharma hrīḥkā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: nyer gcig pa rdzogs rim gyi dbang ni/ lha sngags kyi mtshon pa'i chos thams cad gdod ma nas skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba rang byung 'od gsal chos kyi skur lhun gyis grub par shes pas bsal bzhag med pa rig pa'i rang ngo la mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ hūm̐: de ltar bskyed bzlas bsgom pa'i rim: spros bral chos sku'i yo langs su: ma rtogs gzung 'dzin rgyun mi grol: bsgom med stong gsal dbang thob shog: dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: nyer gnyis pa dngos grub kyi dbang ni/ tshe gal dang tshogs gtor lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: dbang chen yab yum bsgrub pa dang: dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol:

khro bo chen po gshegs nas kyang: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: e ka tsā tī e ā ral+li sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sid+dhi hūm̐: kā ya badz+ra sid+dhi hūm̐: wā ka badz+ra sid+dhi hūm̐: tsit+ta badz+ra sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ṇa badz+ra sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra karma sid+dhi hūm̐: shān+tiṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: puṣ+ṭiṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: pa shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: karma sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: skal ldan khyod la tshe dang dngos grub zhal zas longs spyod sna tshogs kyi dbang bskur pas: bde bar gshegs pa'i sku tshe dang lang tsho la mnga' brnyes shing: mchog dang thun mong phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub kyi dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: ces bskur la tshogs su rol pas dngos grub ya mtshan dam pa thob par gsungs so// de ltar bum pa gtso bor gyur pa'i phyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob pas rjes su yang dbang gi chu bo bar ma chad par gso ba'i phyir/ nya stong brgyad la sogs par phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang mi chag cing bsnyen sgrub khri 'bum gso ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur yang yang blang dgos par gsungs pas de ltar bya snyam du 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ de nas shin tu zab cing gud du sbas pa dbang gong ma gsum zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal phul/ ma rig sgrib g.yogs mtshon byed du gdong dgab par zhu/ zhes dar dmar bkab/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ ho: dpal chen he ru gar gyi bdag: bde chen mchog khyod de nyid stsol: gsang ba'i dam tshig nus pa'i dbang: de nyid bdag la bstsal du gsol: lan gsum/ ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du langs te thal mo spyi bor bzhag /snying gar rdo rje phag mo nas 'bras tsam zhig drag tu 'khrab pa la sems ma yengs par gtod cig

/ bla mas thod rnga 'khrol zhing*/ ho: bu mchog las kyi rdo rje khyod: snying gar phag mo phra ba la: ma yengs rtse gcig de la gtod: bde bas lus kun khyab par ltos: zhes brjod/ bla ma dbang chen yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang chub kyi sems sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa de nyid khyod rang rnams kyi lce la bzhag pas/ rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro til gyi gong bu kha bye ba lta bus gang ba rnams dwangs ma'i bde bas tshims/ gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos shig / ban+dha'i bdud rtsi sbyin la/ ho: gsang ba'i dam tshig mchod chen po: bde ba'i rang bzhin dga' ba che: rtsa khams dag pa'i rang bzhin la: mchog gi dam rdzas bla med 'dis: khyod ni bde ba'i mchog dam 'gyur: bde ba'i rang bzhin stong par ltos: a ho su kha dharma mu dra ra sa ghu ya sa ma ya ho3 haṃ: zhes brjod la gdong g.yogs bsal/ gsum pa sher dbang ni/ de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi thog mar byin dbab pa'i slad du langs te thal mo spyi bor bzhag sogs nas/ khyab par ltos: bar gong ltar lan gcig bskyar/ rig tsag lag tu gtad la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya lag tu gtad pas slob ma yab yum rta mchog dang phag mor gsal ba lha'i 'du shes/ gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang mkha' gsang rdo rje pad+mar byin gyis brlabs pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs lam zab mo 'di la bsten nas 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes gsum dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ 'dod chags chen po'i 'gros las shar ba'i 'khor lo bzhi ru yas babs dang mas brtan gyi rim pas dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba/ dga' bral bde stong chen po'i ngo bo ngos zungs shig /bde la ma chags bde ngos bzung: bde ba'i rang bzhin brjod mi shes: smra brjod bral ba chos kyi sku:

stong pa nyid dang dbyer mi phyed: bu khyod 'di la sred zhen spongs: sred zhen spongs la bde stong skyongs: phyag rgya'i bha gar 'o byed cing dwangs ma lce yis blangs pas rtsa khams kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad bde bas tshims pa dang*/ yum gyis 'di skad brjod par mos shig /nga yi bha ga gsang chen 'di: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gshegs shul te: bu khyod bde ba'i mchog 'dod na: 'di las slar yang bde ba longs: zhes bskul ba la rjes su gus pas 'di skad brjod par mos la rjes zlos/ rā ho3 haṃ: bde ba'i rang bzhin shes rab ma: stong dang snying rje dbyer mi phyed: pad+ma la ni lces len par: bdag gi gus pas cis mi len: zhes brjod cing slar yang pad+ma'i gting nas dwangs ma lces gzhibs te lus gnas khyab par bkram par mos shig /de nas bla mas phyag rgya'i srin lag g.yon nas bzung ste slob ma'i lag g.yas su gtad par gyur/ slar yang rig tsaka gtad la/ a ho: sangs rgyas kun skyed bde ba'i yum: bud med mi spang dang du longs: 'di bral sngags kyi dam tshig nyams: de bas rigs ldan dang du longs: zhes brjod/ ban+dha'i bdud rtsi rol du gzhug go /bzhi pa spros med tshig dbang ni/

de nas don dam tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i yon du gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul bar mos la zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ ye shes dbab pa'i slad du slob bu'i snying gar yi ge a dkar po sran ma tsam ye shes lnga'i 'od 'phro ba'i stobs kyis lus nam mkha' la yod par mos shig / bla mas thod rnga 'khrol zhing*/ a ni skye ba med pa la: lus ni ye shes lnga yi lus: nam mkha'i klong na rang gsal 'bar: lus med nyams kyi rang zhal ltos: zhes brjod la nyams bskyed/ slob bu rnams lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas la/ lta stangs dang rig pa nam mkhar gtod cig /bu khyod sems kyi ngo bor ltos: bltas pas mi mthong ngang la zhog: khyod kyi rig pa shar phyogs kyi: nam mkha'i dbyings su phya ler thongs: de bzhin lho nub byang du yang: khyod kyi sems ni thogs med thongs: btang tshe phyi nang 'gro 'ong med: 'gro bar snyam yang rang gi sems: sems ni ngos bzung 'dzin pa bral: ngo bo stong la rang bzhin gsal: thugs rje'i 'char sgo ma 'gags gsal: de yi rang bzhin nang du ltos: smra bsam brjod med sa le ba: dper na gzhon nu'i bde ba bzhin: nges pa'i shes pa gting gsal can: bu khyod 'di yi rang zhal ltos: 'di zhes mtshan mar ma grub kyang: gsal rig stong pa sing bag can: de don rtogs la ngang du zhog: 'di ni rig pa'i rtsal dbang yin: bu khyod 'di yi rjes skyong na: tshe gcig thar pa'i lam bgrod 'gyur: zhes dal bus brjod la snod bcud kyi rten 'brel 'dzom na de'i don ngo 'phrod nges su bshad do// zur gsal gtor dbang sbrel na skabs 'dir bskur ro// bzhi pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ de ltar na rim pa de dag rnams kyis bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur thun mong ma yin pa mchog dbang gud sbas rnam pa gsum bcas legs par grub pa yin pas/ rjes su dbang srog dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gis bsdus pa'i sa ma ya 'bum sde srog bzhin du bsrung ba dang nyams pa sor chud pa'i skong bshags la 'bad pa sogs/

lung dang man ngag las ji skad bshad pa thams cad nan tan gyis slob cing nyams su blang ba'i brtul zhugs la gnas par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba/ dge bsngo byas te slob ma gyes/ tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma gtang ba sogs dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog rnams kyang las byang ltar tshang bar bya'o// dbang chen pad+ma'i byin rlabs 'od brgya'i thigs// mos yid dpal gyi be'ur sims pa las// gdod ma'i bde chen mkha' khyab sad pa'i stobs// brtan g.yo kun gyi srog tu zhugs gyur cig /ces dbang chog 'di la khungs thub kyi chog bsgrigs dang zin bris gsal bar mi 'dug pas phyag len yang mkhas blun gyi rjes su 'brang ba las gtad so mi snang bas/ so skye'i blos dpag par dka' rung bla ma brgyud pa'i lugs bzhin 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa rtsal gyis/ pad+ma zhi khro'i pho brang dang 'dabs 'byor pa'i gnas dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //
